The RFI is not a contract notice nor a Request for Quotation initiating a procurement process. The purpose of the RFI is to gather information about High-Explosive Fragmentation mines and High-Explosive Blast mines available on the market. This RFI is intended for international Suppliers. Another RFI "34878/2026 Tietopyyntö; Sirpalevaikutteinen miina ja painevaikutteinen miina" for domestic Suppliers is open at the same time to gather information about domestic market. With the RFI, FDF seeks to gather information about the possible Suppliers of antipersonal (AP) mines, Supplier's professional experience and financial standing, and feasible technical and cost-effective solutions of AP mines available on the market. FDF is gathering information about antipersonal mines that are affordable and do not include any intelligence features.
